body.name: Complete-run source collection \(\mathcal R(E)\)
body.construction: From either a generic acquired collection \(E_0\) or a uniform certificate \(E\), retain one copy of each distinct triple consisting of its protocol mask, label mask, and labelled-source mask, and sort the triples lexicographically. The protocol, label, and source masks have lengths \(|\mathcal A|\), \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\), and \(|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\), respectively, so the exact input length is \(N_{\mathrm{src}}=|\mathcal R(E_0)|\bigl(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\bigr)\), or the same expression with \(E\).
